'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]] 
**[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Kyiv strikes (2022–present)|Kyiv strikes]]
****[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] launch an overnight [[ballistic missile]] attack on [[Kyiv]], Ukraine, killing one person and injuring four others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russias-missile-attack-kyiv-kills-one-sparks-fires-ukraine-says-2025-02-12/ (Reuters)]
***[[United States and the Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****After holding a [[2025 Putin–Trump call|telephone call]] with [[President of Russia|Russian president]] [[Vladimir Putin]], [[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] says negotiations to end the war will start immediately. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/02/12/politics/putin-trump-phone-call/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.euronews.com/2025/02/12/donald-trump-holds-phone-call-with-vladimir-putin-on-starting-ukraine-negotiations (Euronews)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]
***The [[Rapid Support Forces]] storm the [[Zamzam Refugee Camp]] in [[North Darfur]], [[Sudan]], the country's largest [[refugee camp|displacement camp]]. The situation inside the camp, which holds around 500,000 people, is described as "catastrophic", with an unknown number of casualties. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ce85x6w22gwo (BBC News)]
*[[Students–People's uprising (Bangladesh)|Students–People's uprising]]
**[[United Nations]] [[Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights|High Commissioner for Human Rights]] [[Volker Türk]] reports that over 1,400 people were killed last year during [[July massacre|violent crackdowns]] on [[2024 Bangladesh quota reform movement|protests]] against the government of former [[Bangladesh]]i Prime Minister [[Sheikh Hasina]] by the [[Bangladesh Armed Forces|military]] and [[Bangladesh Police|police]], with over 78% of the casualties having been [[Gunshot wound|shot]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/un-up-to-1400-killed-in-bangladesh-protests-crackdown/a-71587345 (DW)] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Hamburg train accident]]
**The casualty total from yesterday's collision between an [[Intercity Express]] train and a [[semi-trailer truck]] in [[Hamburg]], [[Germany]], increases to one person killed and 25 injured. [https://euroweeklynews.com/2025/02/12/hamburg-train-crash-leaves-one-dead-and-25-injured/ (EuroWeekly)]
*A [[fishing trawler]] capsizes off [[South Korea]]'s [[Jeju Island]], with five crew members reported missing. Five others are rescued by the [[Korea Coast Guard]]. [https://apnews.com/article/south-korea-fishing-boat-capsize-jeju-island-b898df6e89b5926239b93a99fafee0b0 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russia–Sudan relations]]
**[[Sudan]]ese [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Sudan)|foreign minister]] Ali Yousif Sharif reports that an agreement has been reached for the creation of a [[Russian Navy|Russian naval]] base in Sudan. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2025/02/13/russia-sudan-agree-on-red-sea-naval-base-sudanese-fm (Al Arabiya)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Foreign relations of the United States]]
**[[Belarus–United States relations]]
***U.S. [[White House Press Secretary]] [[Karoline Leavitt]] announces that [[Belarus]] has released three detainees, including an [[Americans|American citizen]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2025/02/12/belarus-releases-three-detainees-including-an-american-white-house-says (Al Arabiya)]
**[[Russia–United States relations]]
***The [[Second presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] agree to send convicted money launderer [[Alexander Vinnik]] back to [[Russia]] in exchange for the release of American teacher [[Marc Fogel]], who was serving a 14-year sentence for entering the country with 17 grams of [[medical cannabis]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-its-getting-back-prisoner-us-return-freeing-teacher-marc-fogel-2025-02-12/ (Reuters)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/politics-news/russian-money-launderer-freed-exchange-marc-fogel-rcna191859 (NBC News)]
*[[2025 Grenoble attack]]
**A man throws a grenade into a bar in [[Grenoble]], France, injuring 15 people, some of whom are in critical condition. [https://www.timesnownews.com/world/europe/grenoble-explosion-grenade-attack-at-villeneuve-village-olympique-local-french-bar-injures-several-locals-video-article-118191432 (Times Now)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Greek presidential election]]
**[[Konstantinos Tasoulas]] is elected [[President of Greece]] by the [[Hellenic Parliament]] in the fourth and final round of the presidential election. [https://www.ekathimerini.com/politics/1261471/konstantinos-tasoulas-elected-new-president-of-greece/ (''Ekathimerini'')]
*[[President of the Senate of Romania|Senate's President]] [[Ilie Bolojan]] becomes acting [[President of Romania]] following [[Klaus Iohannis]]' resignation on 10 February. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/romanian-centrist-leader-takes-over-interim-president-ahead-repeat-election-2025-02-12/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and Technology'''
*[[Neutrino detector|Neutrino detection]]
**Researchers at the [[KM3NeT]] collaboration, published their results on the highest energy [[neutrino]] ever detected. The infrastructure, located at the bottom of the [[Mediterranean Sea]], recorded an event 30 times more energetic than the previous record holder. [https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-024-08543-1 (Nature)], [https://apnews.com/article/high-energy-neutrino-ghost-particle-c8177a5eabdcab2fd045d92e872e1fb1 (AP)]
